visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with high-definition close-up photos of a patient's cheek showing severe acne scarring. The visuals are framed within a black film-strip border labeled with 'Before' and 'After'. The texture of the skin is the primary focus, showing deep pits in the 'Before' shot and significantly smoother skin in the 'After' shot. (2) We transition to a woman wearing glasses and a blue-and-white plaid jacket over a white collared shirt. She is sitting on a brown leather sofa in a bright, professionally lit indoor office environment. She uses frequent hand gestures to emphasize her points while speaking directly to the camera with a friendly expression. (3) A medical animation is displayed, showing a cross-section of the skin's layers, specifically the dermis and epidermis. It highlights blood vessels and fibrous tissue structures related to scarring. The background is a clean, neutral white, and the diagram uses realistic anatomical colors like pink and red for clarity. (4) The camera returns to the female speaker in the office. She continues her explanation, looking engaged and professional. Behind her, the wall features modern vertical wooden slats, adding depth to the background. She continues to use hand motions, pointing and gesturing to complement her speech about treatment costs. (5) The video concludes with a static graphic screen. It displays the clinic's logo, 'DRX Dermatology Clinic,' along with social media handles, a phone number, and physical addresses in New Taipei and Taipei. The background is a clean white, and the text is presented in a professional, easy-to-read layout.
